# Decionis MCP (@decionis/mcp)

> Stdio Model Context Protocol server plus native PreToolUse execution hooks that let AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot) read a repository's DECIONIS_POLICY.md and evaluate candidate actions before they run — locally, with zero network, zero credentials, and nothing recorded. Verdict vocabulary: allow / block / restrain / escalate (API outcomes APPROVE / REJECT / REVIEW / ESCALATE are normalized).

Quickstart:

- Run the server: `npx -y @decionis/mcp` (no install needed)
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add decionis -- npx -y @decionis/mcp`
- Codex (`.codex/config.toml`): `[mcp_servers.decionis]` with `command = "npx"`, `args = ["-y", "@decionis/mcp"]`
- MCP tools: `decionis_read_policy`, `decionis_evaluate`, `decionis_verdict_help`
- Policy file resolution: tool `path` argument → `$DECIONIS_POLICY_PATH` → `./DECIONIS_POLICY.md`
- Native hooks: `npm install -g @decionis/mcp` → `decionis-agent-hook` for codex | copilot | claude; local mode by default, remote mode via `DECIONIS_AGENT_GATE_MODE=remote` + `DECIONIS_API_KEY` + `DECIONIS_ORG_ID`

## Docs

- [MCP protocol docs](https://decionis.com/docs/protocol-mcp?utm_source=github&utm_medium=llms_txt&utm_campaign=dev_discovery): Setup and reference for the Decionis MCP surfaces
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@decionis/mcp): Published package and full usage README
- MCP surface description: https://decionis.com/.well-known/mcp.json
- API contract: https://decionis.com/.well-known/openapi.json
- [Policy Exchange](https://decionis.com/policy-exchange?utm_source=github&utm_medium=llms_txt&utm_campaign=dev_discovery): Forkable policy templates (e.g. claude-code-destructive-shell-gate)

## Try it

- [Sandbox](https://decionis.com/sandbox?utm_source=github&utm_medium=llms_txt&utm_campaign=dev_discovery): Run a live policy check without an account
- [Board](https://board.decionis.com/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=llms_txt&utm_campaign=dev_discovery): Console for policies, verdicts, and Decision Dossiers
